sampling_rule: random.Random(110).sample(sorted(eligible_coordinate_tuples),24); no replacement; canonical source record is lexicographically smallest ID per coordinate
canonicalization: Coordinate deduplicated regardless of sign/dose; all alternate single source IDs retained in eligibility pool; canonical source ID fixed lexicographically, never by reported quality.
explanation_policy: User-required VERBATIM contiguous publisher-description excerpts, with exact excerpt offsets and full descriptions retained only in local source file; no researcher paraphrases. Most excerpts are full first sentences; fragments omit examples, counts, and quality claims without punctuation repair. Two gender records use the exact fragment when asked its gender; their untouched publisher labels supply the male/female label.
forecaster_allowed_file: selected30_atlas.json ONLY; expose coordinates/doses/text according to blinded benchmark arm design; raw snapshots/exclusions/manifest must remain outside fresh forecaster context
sampling_state: Frozen before any110 outputs; full-history source auditor must not serve as fresh masked forecaster
publication_policy: Raw catalog, full schema record, full descriptions, and cooccurrence audit snapshots are LOCAL ONLY; publish only essential methods/results and source-attributed exact excerpt packets if root chooses.
